claim_zh: B5 分类在五个训练种子下保持稳定。
claim_en: B5 classification is stable across five training seeds.
limitation: 仅覆盖 seeds 42–46 和 C1/C2→C5。

claim_zh: 由充分统计量重构的 Federated H1 与 pooled source Ridge 达到实用等价。
claim_en: Federated H1 reconstructed from sufficient statistics is practically equivalent to the pooled source Ridge reference.
canonical_value: 4/4 alpha agreement; max prediction difference 6.2532e-08 ppm
limitation: 数值实用等价，不是形式化安全性证明。

claim_zh: Federated H1 构建期间源端原始行保持本地。
claim_en: Source raw rows remain local during Federated H1 construction.
limitation: 统计量未由安全聚合或差分隐私保护。

claim_zh: Federated-H1 目标个性化满足相对 all-prior 的预注册 1% 非劣标准。
claim_en: Federated-H1 target personalization satisfies the preregistered 1% non-inferiority criterion relative to all-prior regression.
limitation: RG2 在 5/5 seeds 的绝对 S_CC 更低。
forbidden_wording: RG1 is more accurate than RG2

claim_zh: v5 回归核心相对 v4 降低回归参数、bundle 大小和 Pi 延迟。
claim_en: Runtime v5 regression core reduces regression parameters, bundle size, and Raspberry Pi latency relative to runtime v4.
limitation: v5 core 不含 QC，比较需标注角色。
allowed_wording: reduces implementation overhead under the frozen benchmark
forbidden_wording: globally faster in every latency statistic

claim_zh: v5 QC2 富集高误差样本，但因 coverage 与 CO guards 失败而未晋级。
claim_en: Runtime v5 QC2 enriches high-error samples but was not promoted because coverage and CO guards failed.
canonical_value: HC95 yield 93.75%, accepted RMSE 13.9178 ppm; HC90 CO guard failed
limitation: accepted RMSE 必须与 yield 同报。

claim_zh: Runtime v4 保持正式 selective-output baseline。
claim_en: Runtime v4 remains the formal selective-output baseline.
limitation: v5 regression core 与 v4 QC baseline 角色不同。

claim_zh: 目标个性化表现出较高 calibration-budget sensitivity。
claim_en: Target personalization exhibits high calibration-budget sensitivity.
limitation: 描述性 frozen-method sensitivity，不是新独立 confirmatory test。

claim_zh: 两种协议的退化方向一致，但幅度部分依赖协议。
claim_en: Calibration degradation is directionally consistent across protocols while its magnitude is partly protocol-dependent.
limitation: 相同历史 test 被描述性复用。

claim_zh: 历史 240/80 calibration split 是 window-level，非 original-file independent。
claim_en: The historical 240/80 calibration split is window-level and not original-file independent.
limitation: 这是 calibration-internal overlap，不是 test-label leakage。
